deadline.value: Application portal deadline November 1 (for international students and anyone without prior funding). Year inferred: Nov 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

supervisor.value: Two routes: the web portal (international students, or anyone without funding) or direct application with an advisor and funding already arranged
supervisor.quote: apply either through our webportal (for international students) and anyone without prior financial support) or directly, using the forms from the forms section (if you already have an advisor and financial support through them.

funding.value: Applicants without a supervisor or funding apply once a year to the HGSFP portal for a fellowship and to be matched with a supervisor; those who already have both register directly.
funding.quote: Apply for a fellowship | Be matched with a supervisor and doctoral project

also.quote: If no – you are missing either a supervisor or funding (or both)

entry_route.value: Master's in physics normally required (German grade 2.0, about B+). Exceptional candidates with 4 years of physics can enter an integrated 4+4 master/doctoral track
entry_route.quote: the usual requirement is that students must have obtained the minimum of a Master´s degree in Physics or equivalent.

also.quote: Excellent candidates who have completed four years of study in physics can be admitted to the integrated master/doctoral (4+4) programme of the HGSFP

notes: Degree awarded: Dr. rer. nat. The HGSFP forms page lists separate requirements for astronomy candidates, so astronomy is covered here.
